# Sanctioned examples of the RETIRED raw-install form, keyed by a hash of the
# command (whitespace-normalised).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. TestNoRawCopyIntoInstallRoots forbids copying a binary
# straight over an install root. Without an escape hatch it would also forbid
# DOCUMENTING that form -- so nobody could write "do not do this: cp X <root>/X"
# in a warning, and the guard would prevent explaining the failure it exists to
# prevent.
#
# Deciding from surrounding prose whether a command is being endorsed or
# prohibited is not something a regex can do (the same conclusion reached for
# apiKeyHelper mentions). So each sanctioned example is listed here instead,
# which makes adding one a deliberate act a human reviews.
#
# To add an entry: run
#   go test ./internal/deploy/ -run TestNoRawCopyIntoInstallRoots
# The failure prints the command and the line to paste. Read it first -- if it
# is real install guidance rather than a warning, fix the guidance instead.
#
# Stale entries fail the test, so this file cannot drift into fiction.

5f20c0f20d89c01c  # mk/install-go-bin.mk: the retired form, shown in the "do NOT use it" warning
